title: docs(site): refresh the English deck PDF under apps/docs/public/decks to the 19-slide version with the prologue
body:
立卡门类别 ③ — 维护者直派的任务 (maintainer-directed task).

## Maintainer ruling (verbatim, untranslated)

> 开 PR 替换仓库里的英文 PDF

Given in session https://claude.ai/code/session_011hRnra93sK5Q2gTYYTbdJR on 2026-10-12, after the deck itself was revised on the maintainer's two earlier instructions in the same session: open with the future to hold the audience's attention ("开头怎么用未来吸引用户的注意力"), then review the whole deck for order and remove repetition ("通篇审一下整个PPT，包括顺序，并避免重复").

## What lands

`apps/docs/public/decks/the-ontology-is-the-software.pdf` replaced in place: the same deck "The Ontology Is the Software — How a large model reads an enterprise", now 19 pages instead of 17, about 778 KB, vector text, fonts embedded, byline "ObjectStack Team". Same path, so the link the blog essay carries (landed by #22263 / PR #22264) keeps working unchanged.

What changed in the deck since #22253 / PR #22254:

- Two prologue slides after the cover: "Enterprise software changed its interface three times. Its user never changed." (terminals and forms, web and mobile, a conversation box; the first new user in forty years is an agent) and "A company, a few years from now, nine in the morning" (a four-beat scene ending on the question "take the people out and switch the systems off, what is left of the enterprise?").
- Repetition trimmed on seven slides so that each line is said once: the five-part definition is no longer listed a fourth time, "models change, the ontology stays" is said once, "one change, four places" once, the "written wrong does not ship" line once, and the future table's column reads "A few years from now" to answer the prologue.

## Guardrails

- One file, one binary, replaced at its existing path. No `packages/**`, no `content/**`, no README, no app code.
- Nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`.
- No model identifiers anywhere.
- Seat-executed, as #22253 was (the PDF is printed from the deck artifact only this session can reach). The instruction says open the PR; it does not say merge it, so the PR is left as a draft for the maintainer to land.

## Duplicate check (2026-10-12, open and closed)

- Query "replace refresh English deck PDF apps/docs/public/decks the ontology is the software new version": 2 hits — #22253 (the first PDF, closed) and #22263 (the blog link, closed). Neither refreshes the file.
